Looking for plenty of action, local knowledge, and a personalised fishing adventure in Airlie Beach, QLD?
Airlie Beach Fishing Charters are the local experts in fishing the waters in Airlie Beach, QLD. Your half day fishing charter will take you to some of the best fishing locations on board our 10.8 metre vessel with quality fishing equipment and tackle.
What will we be doing and what will we be targeting? We will go trolling from location to location to target spanish mackerel or tuna, but we will mainly be reef fishing/bottom bashing to catch fish such as coral trout, sweet lip, red emperor, and so much more.
• 
Trip Inclusions 
• 
• Bottled Water & Ice
• Environmental Park Fee (Reef Tax) Per Person
• All High-Quality Equipment: Rods, Reels, & Bait – proudly sponsored by Shimano.
• All Fish Cleaned & Packed – for you to take with you!
• 
What To Bring 
• 
• Sunscreen
• Hat
• Sunnies
• Jacket/Jumper – mostly for winter months.
• Camera – a must!
• BYO Snacks – no bananas, please!
• BYO Alcohol – in cans and in moderate amount, please!
